Core

Use of English

Comprehension passages, lexis and structure, register, grammar, and oral English forms required for all UTME candidates.

Sciences

Mathematics

Number bases, algebra, polynomials, geometry, trigonometry, statistics, probability, and introductory calculus.

Sciences

Physics

Mechanics, thermal physics, waves, optics, electricity, magnetism, and modern atomic physics principles.

Sciences

Chemistry

Stoichiometry, atomic structure, chemical bonding, kinetics, electrochemistry, inorganic, and organic chemistry.

Sciences

Biology

Cell structure, diversity of organisms, plant and animal physiology, ecology, heredity, genetics, and evolution.

Sciences

Agricultural Science

Crop and animal production, soil science, agronomy, farm management, forestry, and agricultural economics.

Sciences

Computer Studies

Computing fundamentals, hardware architecture, data representation, software systems, networking, and algorithms.

Arts

Christian Religious Studies

Old Testament themes, the synoptic Gospels, history of the early church, and Christian moral teachings.

Arts

Islamic Religious Studies

Qur'anic studies, Hadith, Tawhid, Fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence), Sirah, and Islamic civilization history.

Commercial

Commerce

Production, home and foreign trade, banking, insurance, transportation, marketing, and business law.

Arts

Literature in English

African and non-African drama, prose, and poetry analysis with focus on literary appreciation and devices.

Commercial

Economics

Micro and macroeconomic theory, price determination, national income, money, public finance, and international trade.

Commercial

Government

Elements of government, political ideologies, constitutional development in Nigeria, public administration, and foreign policy.

Commercial

Geography

Practical map reading, physical geography, human settlement patterns, environmental hazards, and regional geography of Nigeria.

Arts

History

Pre-colonial Nigerian states, British colonial administration, nationalist movements, post-independence Nigeria, and African history.
